card.name: Small words in legal definitions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (on, in, of, a, by) inside legal text about conventions, contracts, heirs and patents. They come mid-sentence in a definition or treaty description.

modes.label: Treaty descriptions
modes.description: Small words inside a sentence about an international convention and where or when it was concluded.

modes.label: Succession law definitions
modes.description: Small words inside dictionary-style definitions of heirs and inheritance by contract.
modes.example: A conventional heir is one who takes a succession<< by>> virtue of a contract

modes.label: Patent law rules
modes.description: Small words in statements about who may file a patent application.
modes.example: whether he is<< a>> citizen of Bangladesh or not
